title: Source-faithful rule extraction and execution research matrix
status: all experiments prospective; historical evidence cited is already completed audit, not execution of this plan
semantic_profile_policy: reference IR declares logic_profile, domain completeness and conflict handling; classical FOL equivalence is not runtime K3 equivalence

data_partitions.confirmation: fresh sources and natural cases, source/concept/guideline-family/case-duplicate audit required

method_arms.M1: deterministic fixes only, same extraction, unsupported flat semantics retained as loss
method_arms.M3: M2 plus composition, source-visible countermodel validation and bounded rollback repair
method_arms.M4: independently human-adjudicated reference IR/facts/joins as separately specified conditional oracles
method_arms.N1: actual-source RAG baseline with verified retrieval wiring

source_metrics.primary_denominator: adjudicable independent source rule/group inventory: F+D+O
source_metrics.F: all required source slots and full-group structure faithfully represented
source_metrics.D: traceable counterpart with meaning distortion, partial group, omitted qualifiers or wrong structure
source_metrics.ambiguity: separate source A count, excluded from adjudicable denominator, conservative sensitivity bound reported
source_metrics.multiple_outputs: source recall and conflict-free full-output-package fidelity both reported
source_metrics.atomic_vs_group: separate strata; leaves do not replace whole-group denominator

output_metrics.denominator: all identifiable generated rule/group units including semantically recoverable malformed outputs
output_metrics.strict_H: no traceable source ancestor after documented bounded source search; not mere distortion or missing citation
output_metrics.counts: raw and semantically deduplicated counts both reported
output_metrics.unsegmentable: report separately without inventing number of units

budget_policies.equal_tokens: common total token allowance, actual spending separately reported
budget_policies.no_best_of: only preregistered deployable aggregation; independent repetitions not selected by gold

decision_gates.G0: Complete reconstructible lineage, denominators, independent references and historical replay.
decision_gates.G1: All preregistered reference vectors within the supported logic_profile pass; legitimate hard effects retained; unresolved structure does not authorize hard actions.

G2.source_group_recall: paired interval lower bound above zero versus M1
G2.coprimary: conflict-free complete-output-package source fidelity passes prespecified gate
G2.output_constraints: faithful output precision noninferiority plus strict-H and unresolved-provenance bounds
G2.atomic_constraint: prespecified atomic fidelity noninferiority; minus 2pp is a planning candidate only
G2.coverage: fully reported with abstention; hypotheses and margins fixed after new development pilot, before confirmation

decision_gates.G3: Some source-IR benefit retained with automatic facts/joins; identity perturbations and trace accounting pass.
decision_gates.G4: Dev-frozen hard-action threshold passes independent risk bound and nonzero coverage/legitimate-hard-action recall requirements.
decision_gates.G5: One preregistered complete-diagnosis primary comparison at common budget passes, with risk and all secondary endpoints disclosed.

statistical_unit: source families for source-rule metrics; cases plus source-family clustering for diagnosis; transformations/repetitions remain nested
stopping: fixed maximum samples/calls and repair attempts; no unplanned significance peeking; freeze dev-selected thresholds before confirmation

experiments.title: 谱系、缓存和端点重建
experiments.falsifiable_question: 同一冻结输入能否逐层还原规则和最终结果，而不是只复现MRR？

design.unit: historical run and new run manifest
factors: full candidate identity and task-role endpoint

experiments.primary_endpoint: every planned unit has reconstructible lineage and endpoint denominator
experiments.falsification_or_failure: any unexplained stage drift or denominator loss; reused output called an independent replicate
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: historical run; no population inferential claim

experiments.title: 独立来源库存和参考IR
experiments.falsifiable_question: 来源全规则库存是否揭示输出导向抽样遗漏的复杂规则与非诊断语义？

design.unit: source-first probability-sampled window with complete neighboring rule context
design.masking: reviewers do not see method output or case rank before source inventory is frozen

experiments.primary_endpoint: adjudicable unique source rule/group inventory and independent semantic reference
experiments.falsification_or_failure: reference inventory derives from successful extractions; groups counted by leaves; reviewers infer rule truth from gold diagnosis
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: source-family clusters; probability weights for population estimates

experiments.title: 递归解释器和动作内核验收
experiments.falsifiable_question: 在已知参考IR和事实下，整个规则而非命中叶子决定诊断动作吗？

design.unit: independent reference rule plus minimal world
vectors: known witness/false counterexample in incomplete domains

experiments.primary_endpoint: all preregistered supported-fragment truth and authorized-action vectors agree with independent reference
secondary_endpoints: classical equivalence versus K3 unknown behavior
experiments.falsification_or_failure: unknown source-rule structure or unresolved root truth authorizes a hard action; disabling all hard actions counted as success; bounded search reported as universal proof
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: rule family and semantic operator; synthetic tests not clinical risk estimates

experiments.title: 仅实现修复的冻结回放
experiments.falsifiable_question: 修确定性缺陷能否改变其明确作用通道，且是否揭开被旧错误压住的竞争项？
experiments.primary_endpoint: trace-level patch effect and residual error propagation on all candidates
experiments.falsification_or_failure: rank rescue treated as clinical correctness; genuine coexisting-lesion evidence deleted to help the target
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: 11 development cases only; interventions are targeted conditional effects

experiments.title: 提示词、表示容量与受约束生成
experiments.falsifiable_question: 递归表示和约束是否提高完整源组忠实率，而不仅是可解析率？

arms: M1 same extraction plus loss-reporting adapter

experiments.primary_endpoint: source-weighted complete-group F recall with atomic F/D/O separate
experiments.falsification_or_failure: only parse rate rises; flat-unrepresentable units silently removed; full text hidden in macro strings scored as executable

experiments.title: 谓词身份与逻辑结构双oracle
experiments.falsifiable_question: 主要瓶颈是指错对象，还是正确对象的连词/量词/方向关系被误译？

design.incompatible_interface_policy: retain and report; never silently restrict to easy oracle-compatible subset

experiments.primary_endpoint: paired full-rule fidelity and semantic-equivalence gaps across four cells
experiments.falsification_or_failure: oracle silently adds knowledge absent from source; identity and structure given together but attributed to just one axis
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: source-family clusters; conditional ceilings, not deployable accuracy

experiments.title: 组合解析的增量
experiments.falsifiable_question: 分离原子和依赖、保留歧义是否比直接递归输出更忠实？

arms: direct repeated sampling with frozen aggregation

experiments.primary_endpoint: complete-group F recall at matched resource allowances
experiments.falsification_or_failure: extra stages add common-sense restrictions or erase source ambiguity; gains vanish against equal-budget independent translation
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: source-family clusters; repeated calls nested within rule

experiments.title: 反模型验证与修复四格
experiments.falsifiable_question: 源文恢复和反模型是否使修对多于修坏，而非只提高可执行率？

design.repair_limit: preregistered bounded attempts and total budget

experiments.primary_endpoint: net source-faithfulness correction and wrong-to-right/right-to-wrong paired counts
experiments.falsification_or_failure: self-generated reference validates shared misreading; more syntax-valid but more semantically wrong outputs; harmful repair rate offsets correction
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: source-family clusters; condition on pre-repair state and also report all-rule intent-to-treat

experiments.title: 保义变换与重复证据不变性
experiments.falsifiable_question: 意义不变时，身份、组真值和诊断权限是否保持？

design.unit: source rule and independently validated meaning-preserving transformed pair
design.controls: independent reviewer verifies source equivalence before model scoring

experiments.primary_endpoint: full-rule equivalence and authorized-action invariance across meaning-preserving pairs
secondary_endpoints: score sensitivity to repeated same claim
experiments.falsification_or_failure: new synonyms merge parents/siblings; repeated text increases criteria count or hard evidence; invariant incorrect output called success
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: original source family; transformed replicas not independent sources

experiments.title: 语义反转和作用域敏感性
experiments.falsifiable_question: 当原文只改变关键逻辑槽位时，抽取器能作恰当而局部的语义改变吗？

design.unit: minimal semantic contrast with known distinguishing world

experiments.primary_endpoint: correct changed-slot extraction and correct action divergence on distinguishing worlds
experiments.falsification_or_failure: method outputs same rule for opposite meanings or changes unrelated slots; a proposed contrast lacks a distinguishing world
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: source/contrast family; no population accuracy claim from handpicked mutants

experiments.title: 参考IR、患者事实、连接与执行交叉
experiments.falsifiable_question: 更忠实源规则的收益在哪里被患者表示、连接或执行再次丢失？

design.unit: new case with source-supported reference rule and fixed candidates
design.oracle_policy: references contain only source/vignette licensed information; incompatible cells reported

experiments.primary_endpoint: layer-specific conditional gap in correct rule satisfaction and authorized actions
secondary_endpoints: full-target rank conditional on candidate presence
experiments.falsification_or_failure: facts+joins joint oracle attributed only to extraction; richer oracle invents facts; target-specific manual joins reported deployable
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: case and source-family clusters; factorial conditional effects

experiments.title: 概念身份、候选干扰与任务层级
experiments.falsifiable_question: 同义重复/父类顺序或合法共存病灶会不会偷走知识并改变不相关动作？

design.unit: fixed-candidate case plus controlled candidate-set variant
design.causal_composite_policy: judge truth and question-target adequacy separately

experiments.primary_endpoint: identity-preserving allocation and stable authorized actions under harmless candidate changes
experiments.falsification_or_failure: legal lesion evidence deleted as distractor; alias recall improves by unsafe parent/child or benign/malignant merge
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: original case; candidate variants are paired perturbations

experiments.title: 后端差分、评分程序与元规则
experiments.falsifiable_question: 在同一语义IR下，Python/树/图/逻辑后端是否实现同一授权而非仅能执行？

design.unit: supported reference IR plus minimal world and authorized action
program_classes: signed score with exclusive bands and unknown interval
design.compile_rule: CNF/DNF are derived views; auxiliary definitions and projection preserved only within declared logic_profile; classical equivalence does not authorize K3 program substitution

experiments.primary_endpoint: proof/action/score equivalence within each backend's declared supported fragment
secondary_endpoints: invalid context counted in soft scores
experiments.falsification_or_failure: equisatisfiable encoding presented as unrestricted same-variable equivalence; classical A OR NOT A simplified to TRUE under K3 with unknown A; metarules converted into diagnosis votes; backend silently defaults null to false
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: rule/program class; deterministic conformance, not empirical source fidelity

experiments.title: 来源恢复、格式和真实曝光的拆分
experiments.falsifiable_question: v2内容恢复本身是否有益，还是格式与检索替换改变了被误用的证据？

design.unit: same-document/focus paired payload and fixed case
design.controlled_2x2: restoration×format only where all cells independently validated

held_constant: candidate and patient interfaces in module comparison
experiments.primary_endpoint: source F/D/O and layer-specific complete-target change attributable to controlled content or format
experiments.falsification_or_failure: historical old/v2 non-superset comparison called pure source completeness effect; changed focus or truncation hidden
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: source-document/focus pairs and case clusters; system swap kept distinct from controlled effects

experiments.title: 成本分配与重复运行边界
experiments.falsifiable_question: 更多调用的提升来自有效验证信息，还是采样次数、provider或成功运行筛选？

budgets.equal_tokens: preregistered common total caps and actual spending ledger

design.repeats: development 5 independent runs for key arms; confirmation repeat count frozen before sample planning
design.aggregation: frozen deployable policy, never oracle best-of-run

held_constant: budget accounting including retries and failures
experiments.primary_endpoint: fidelity-cost frontier and between-run variance under paired budgets
secondary_endpoints: complete diagnosis cost frontier when applicable
experiments.falsification_or_failure: equal cap reported exact equal consumption; cached bytes treated independent runs; verifier benefits only above competing budget
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: source-family and case clusters; runs nested, not extra independent cases

experiments.title: 硬动作选择性、覆盖和错误风险
experiments.falsifiable_question: 能否保留真实刚性规则的效果，同时以明确覆盖代价控制误排除/误确认？

design.unit: new independent case with fixed rulebase; separate source-family validation for rule generalization
design.thresholds: select on development only; freeze one confirmation threshold and coverage floor
design.coverage: accepted hard-eligible rule and actionable case coverage; legitimate-hard-action recall

experiments.primary_endpoint: preregistered hard-error risk upper bound together with minimum coverage and legitimate-hard-action recall
experiments.falsification_or_failure: abstain-all declared safe success; correlated actions put into exact binomial bound; zero-event bootstrap gives zero upper bound
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: independent case binary events conditional on fixed rulebase; source-family events for cross-family generalization

experiments.title: 固定完整候选的临床转化
experiments.falsifiable_question: 候选覆盖被固定后，忠实源规则能否提高完整任务选择，而非只抬高父类？

design.unit: new development/pilot case with independently fixed complete candidate set
design.oracles: separately labeled conditional ceilings, human costs excluded from deployable comparison only by separate table

experiments.primary_endpoint: complete-label top1 conditional on fixed candidate presence
experiments.falsification_or_failure: proxy gain claimed complete diagnosis improvement; oracle passage answer gives gold name without matching diagnostic support; fixed-pool result called end-to-end
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: case clusters; fixed candidate conditional endpoint

experiments.title: 全新来源与自然病例确认
experiments.falsifiable_question: 冻结方案能否在独立自然病例、完整诊断和共同预算下优于对照且满足风险门？

design.unit: fresh naturally occurring independent case with source-family split
design.primary_endpoint_default: complete diagnosis top1; top3 may replace only before unblinding
design.sample_size: pilot-estimated paired discordance; precise design simulation after method and endpoints frozen
design.reused_data_policy: 11 cases, 64 windows, 180 outputs and prior DA400+MCR400 are development only

experiments.primary_endpoint: paired complete-diagnosis improvement for the one prespecified primary comparison plus risk gate
experiments.falsification_or_failure: held-out reused for repair; only proxy improves; source or case near-duplicates cross split; risk bound or coverage gate fails; best run chosen
experiments.analysis_dependence_unit: case and source-family clusters; repeated runs not independent cases
